ours.title: OURS: SpatialGym-100K (dataset) and SpatialGym-Bench (environment)
ours.meta: 🟦 Isaac Sim, SimReady warehouses and smart spaces, fixed cameras · planned, nothing rendered yet

cells.title: fixed-camera still
cells.text: warehouse aisle from 8 to 20 ft, 30 to 60 deg tilt; RGB, depth, masks, 3D boxes (VANTAGE camera prior)

cells.title: twin pair
cells.text: same scene, ONE object moved; same question, flipped answer; built from exact state, not edited by an LLM

cells.title: posed multi-view set
cells.text: three cameras of one scene with known poses; camera-camera and region-region relations (MMSI style)

cells.title: person with exact orientation
cells.text: "from the worker's view, where is the pallet?"; 18 direction bins (ViewSpatial human-perspective tasks)

cells.title: event clip
cells.text: forklift near-miss; event start and end from the event log; per-frame poses give track IoU (VANTAGE timing, tracking)

cells.title: graded checker item
cells.text: "distance between the cart and the door?" answer 4.2 m; credit bands within 10 and 25 percent

cells.title: difficulty knobs
cells.text: occlusion 40 percent, 12 objects, tilt 55 deg, distance ratio 1.3 logged per item; pass rate per bin

cells.title: RL prompt with typed negative
cells.text: generator seed plus checker as the reward; the DPO rejected answer is the mirror-flip failure

cells.title: environment step
cells.text: reset(seed) returns a fresh image set and question; step(answer) returns graded credit from the checker plus the twin verdict; SpatialGym-Bench is this loop with frozen seeds

ours.note: 🧪 Test split, frozen before training: held-out camera levels 14 to 20 ft, scenes 41 to 50, asset set 2, twin types occlude and swap view, two-skill compositions (see the OUR Benchmark tab).
